label: Classwork 3
prompt: For an exponential function, the output halfway between two inputs is found by:
choices: Taking the geometric mean (square root of the product) of the two outputs
answer: Taking the geometric mean (square root of the product) of the two outputs
solution: Equal input steps multiply by equal factors, so the middle output is √(y₁·y₂).
explanation: Averaging would only work for linear functions.
